## What's Changed

**NOTE:** This release is a unified release of the NVIDIA Container Toolkit that consists of the following packages:
* [`libnvidia-container 1.20.1`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/libnvidia-container/releases/tag/v1.20.1)
* [`nvidia-container-toolkit 1.20.1`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/releases/tag/v1.20.1)

The packages for this release are published to the [`libnvidia-container` package repositories](https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/).

### Fixes and Features

- CDI specifications and JIT-CDI mode now inject MIG management capability devices into containers. Set the NVIDIA_MIG_CONFIG_DEVICES or NVIDIA_MIG_MONITOR_DEVICES environment variable to all in a container with CAP_SYS_ADMIN to inject the /dev/nvidia-caps/ device nodes for MIG partition management. For supported values and constraints, refer to [MIG Management Devices](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/1.20.1/docker-specialized.html#id2). For more information, refer to [issue #1740](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/issues/1740) and [PR #1947](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/1947).
- Containers can now enforce soft and hard per-GPU CUDA memory limits. Set the NVIDIA_GPU_MEMORY_REQUEST and NVIDIA_GPU_MEMORY_LIMIT environment variables in MiB to control the limits. This feature requires an R615 or later driver. For more information, refer to [PR #2075](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2075).
- Containers running with an R615 or later driver now receive the GPU firmware files that the driver requires at runtime. CDI specifications include the ucode_*.bin files automatically. For more information, refer to [PR #2095](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2095).
- The nvidia-ctk runtime configure command now preserves existing Docker feature flags when enabling CDI. Previously, running the command could overwrite flags such as containerd-snapshotter. For more information, refer to [PR #2049](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2049).
- Fixed an intermittent EBADF error in the create-symlinks hook that caused container creation to fail on busy hosts. The error occurred when the garbage collector closed a file descriptor while a system call was in progress. For more information, refer to [PR #2082](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2082).
- Fixed a regression in the update-ldcache hook that caused container creation to fail under gVisor. The hook now uses a sealed memfd to execute ldconfig, which avoids mounting /proc inside the container root. For more information, refer to [PR #2059](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2059).
- On WSL2, setting NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=none now correctly prevents GPU device injection. For more information, refer to [PR #2025](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2025).
- Fixed NVIDIA X.Org driver module mount paths so that containers render correctly when the host uses a custom ModulePath in xorg.conf.d. For more information, refer to [PR #1980](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/1980).
- GPU devices are now available in the CDI specification on first boot. The nvidia-cdi-refresh systemd service creates NVIDIA control device nodes before generating the specification. For more information, refer to [PR #1979](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/1979).
- GPU containers that start at boot no longer fail due to missing device nodes. The nvidia-cdi-refresh service is now ordered before Docker, containerd, and CRI-O. For more information, refer to [PR #2019](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2019).
- Containers on read-only filesystems no longer fail to start when the application profile cannot be updated. The update-application-profile hook now ignores read-only filesystem errors. For more information, refer to [PR #2028](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2028).
- Fixed malformed hook scratch directory names that could prevent hooks from running correctly. For more information, refer to [PR #2042](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/2042).
- Containers running under crun with user namespaces no longer encounter permission errors when resolving the rootfs path. The OCI state parser now uses the non-standard root field from crun. For more information, refer to [PR #1971](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/pull/1971).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/compare/v1.20.0...v1.20.1

## Overview

This release adds the LiquidAI LFM3 family (text, vision, audio and omni) together with a new experimental streaming-audio API in `mtmd`, and wires realtime audio in and out of the server through the new `/v1/realtime` and `/tts` endpoints. A batch of new architectures landed: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, SenseNova U1, Beam, Kolibri-1, Flint, Muse Spark, Granite Switch Decision, plus decision/embedding models from LiquidAI, Baidu and NVIDIA. The core got sparse-attention (QSA/DSA) reworked onto a fused masking op, a 50/50 SLRU cache for host-resident MoE experts, and cleaner `no_alloc` memory handling; the server got router memory-management and tool-calling improvements; the UI can now browse and download models straight from HF Hub, search conversations and compact them. Finally, `ggml` was bumped to v0.28.0, bringing `GGML_OP_TOP_K_MASK`, `-1` expert-index semantics and large backend performance work (CUDA chunked graph launches, SYCL graph replay, OpenCL Q2_K/Q3_K, Hexagon HTP rework, KleidiAI SVE kernels).

### Highlights

- LFM3 family: LFM3-1.7B (text) and LFM3-VL-2B (vision), verified against the reference HF implementation [llama/31252](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31252)
- LFM3-Audio-2B and LFM3-Omni-2B: ASR, TTS and voice chat from a single model, with streaming audio input and output [llama/31257](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31257)

### API changes

- DRY sampler: new `LLAMA_DRY_MAX_SEQ_BREAKERS` (64) caps distinct sequence breakers, each costing `O(n_vocab)` at init [llama/31035](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31035)
- `mtmd`: new experimental `mtmd_audio_stream` API turning PCM fed as it arrives into decoder-ready embedding rows [llama/30629](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30629)
- `mtmd`: audio generation is now stateful - `mtmd_gen_state` replaces the raw `state_data` buffers of the audio gen API [llama/30902](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30902)
- `mtmd`: `mtmd_caps` gained `gen_audio`; new TTS types `SOPRANO` and `LFM3A`; repetition penalty for sampled codes [llama/28607](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28607) [llama/31257](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31257)
- `mtmd_helper_get_capabilities()` to query the capabilities of an mmproj file from helper code [llama/31183](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31183)
- Server: new `/v1/realtime` endpoint implementing the OpenAI realtime protocol for conversation and transcription [llama/31269](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31269) [llama/30636](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30636)
- Server: new `POST /tts` endpoint for text-to-speech models [llama/26603](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26603)
- Server: reasoning effort levels of the chat template are exposed and selectable via the API [llama/31271](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31271)
- Chat API: support for deferred tools and `tool_reference` content parts [llama/31256](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31256)
- CLI: `--model` or `-hf` is now required [llama/31242](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31242)

### New models

- LiquidAI LFM3-1.7B, LFM3-VL-2B, LFM3-Audio-2B, LFM3-Omni-2B [llama/31252](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31252) [llama/31257](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31257)
- LiquidAI d1-2B and d1-omni-2B decision models [llama/31275](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31275)
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash [llama/31086](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31086)
- SenseNova U1 [llama/28919](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28919)
- Beam (Reflection) [llama/30670](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30670)
- Kolibri-1 (Aleph-Alpha) [llama/30673](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30673)
- Flint [llama/30928](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30928)
- Muse Spark Open (text, vision and audio) [llama/30616](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30616)
- Granite Switch Decision, including the 256-way decision head [llama/30676](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30676) [llama/30693](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30693)
- Nemotron-3(.5)-Embed, with non-standard GQA and BPE tokenizer support [llama/30877](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30877) [llama/23343](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/23343)
- H2O-Lightning-4B decision model [llama/30361](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30361)
- MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 and MiniCPM-OCR-Jev [llama/30979](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30979) [llama/30980](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30980)
- Soprano TTS [llama/28607](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28607)
- LFM2 short-conv and FFN blocks moved into a shared LFM base reused by newer LFM models [llama/30874](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30874)

### Core changes

- MoE experts kept in host memory now use a 50/50 SLRU cache instead of a plain LRU cache [llama/30637](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30637)
- Sparse attention: fused QSA mask op, QSA/DSA selection built without `kq_mask`, k-pool views shared between layers [llama/30640](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30640) [llama/31009](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31009) [llama/30965](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30965) [llama/31243](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31243) [llama/30613](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30613)
- MoE: amax rescaling enabled for `laguna`, and `-sm tensor` denied on arches that use it [llama/31147](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31147) [llama/31081](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31081)
- Memory: `no_alloc` respected in all memory caches, moved out of `llama_hparams`, obsolete `n_pad` dropped [llama/31087](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31087) [llama/31141](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31141) [llama/31200](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31200)
- Vocabulary loading optimized; `d2t` placed next to its `set_rows` use so it can stay on the GPU [llama/30679](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30679) [llama/30912](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30912)
- Tokenizer: new `clean_spaces` and metaspace prepend-scheme GGUF keys, hybrid DNA tokenizer fixes [llama/30940](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30940) [llama/30825](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30825)
- Tokenizer: Tekken pre-tokenizer for Pixtral, `\p{M}` in Tekken/GPT-4o lookaheads, Nemotron-3.5-Embed tokenization fix [llama/30960](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30960) [llama/30845](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30845) [llama/30974](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30974)
- Grammar: recursion depth limited (and enforced) to prevent stack overflow; deep JSON rejected before walking it [llama/29755](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29755) [llama/31153](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31153) [llama/30242](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30242)
- Qwen: merge tensors on convert, 2D output reshape, Qwen3 bidirectional attention and `dense_2` output projection [llama/31028](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31028) [llama/30823](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30823) [llama/30607](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30607)
- Speculative decoding: persist the dynamic ngram cache, probabilistic DFlash2 drafts, optional DFlash FC input scale [llama/22055](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/22055) [llama/30663](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30663) [llama/30945](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30945) [llama/30927](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30927)
- LoRA: support for `prism.hadamard` folded weights [llama/30910](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30910)
- Tensor parallel: `stepfun` and `laguna` now support 4-10 GPUs [llama/24554](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24554)
- GGUF tools reject truncated tensor data in `split`, `export-lora` and `merge` [llama/30497](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30497) [llama/31044](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31044)
- `llama-quant`: fix 4D tensor quantization with `ggml_nrows()` and name-based expert detection [llama/30820](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30820)
- `convert-hf`: faster endian conversion with more datatypes, text-only checkpoints in pplx-decider [llama/30647](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30647) [llama/30575](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30575)
- `convert-hf`: fixes for Granite speech tensors, Granite Switch MultiSwitch block count, Mistral-format DeepseekV2 [llama/30628](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30628) [llama/30621](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30621) [llama/30669](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30669)
- Common: honor `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`, allow concurrent downloads, pin model resolution on real HF repo layouts [llama/21752](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/21752) [llama/29312](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29312) [llama/30548](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30548)

### Multi-modality changes

- Streaming audio input via `mtmd_audio_stream`, used to support `voxtral-realtime` [llama/30629](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30629)
- Soprano TTS support and MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 support [llama/28607](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28607) [llama/30979](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30979)
- Image preprocessing aligned with transformers/torchvision: LFM2 resize, tiles and layout, Qwen-VL resize [llama/30943](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30943) [llama/30261](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30261) [llama/30736](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30736)
- LFM2 tiling parameters are read from the GGUF metadata [llama/30840](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30840)
- `lightonocr` defaults to native resolution instead of forcing a 1540 longest edge [llama/30600](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30600)
- `build_inp_temporal_merge` moved to the `mtmd` base class; fix Gemma-4 FFN activation [llama/31065](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31065) [llama/30882](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30882)

### Server changes

- Realtime conversation and transcription on `/v1/realtime`, with `response.done` sent after the committed audio drains [llama/31269](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31269) [llama/30636](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30636) [llama/30994](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30994)
- `POST /tts` endpoint for TTS models [llama/26603](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26603)
- Expose the reasoning effort levels of the chat template [llama/31271](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31271)
- Router: configurable device memory margin for dynamic unloading of models [llama/21231](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/21231)
- Router: propagate client disconnects to the child task, stop re-adding the mmproj margin on sleep/resume [llama/29707](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29707) [llama/28233](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28233)
- Rerank endpoint accepts typed content input and substitutes the placeholder from the original template [llama/29625](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29625) [llama/30864](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30864)
- Anthropic `/v1/messages`: forward llama.cpp sampling params and pass `id_slot` through the conversion [llama/30856](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30856) [llama/28554](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28554)
- Support `logprobs` together with speculative decoding [llama/27196](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27196)
- Fix `usage.completion_tokens` undercounting with `n > 1` and missing `output_index` in Responses API SSE events [llama/29486](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29486) [llama/30863](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30863)
- Fix SWA checkpoint invalidation logic [llama/30666](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30666)
- New `--connect` flag to allow p2p access to the server outside the LAN [llama/28277](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28277)

### UI changes

- Discover and download models directly from HF Hub, with org-less models listed first [llama/29584](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29584) [llama/31215](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31215)
- New search dialog for conversations and messages [llama/31173](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31173)
- Conversation compaction to keep long chats within the context [llama/27401](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27401)
- Models manager moved to its own route, model details open in a drawer without leaving the page [llama/30988](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30988) [llama/31176](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31176)
- Reasoning menu built from the chat template's effort levels, with a clearer highlighted toggle [llama/31273](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31273) [llama/31212](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31212)
- Support OGG audio attachments by converting them to WAV [llama/31237](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31237)
- New "Show tool call in progress" setting [llama/30681](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30681)
- Save and reset settings buttons shown only when there are unsaved changes [llama/31248](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31248)
- Sidebar resizing and general layout/UX improvements [llama/31119](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31119) [llama/31030](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31030)
- Fixes: draft lost after "Add System Message", system row stretching in WebKit [llama/31214](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31214) [llama/31246](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31246)
- Fixes: clipped attachment text preview, markdown tables and lists cut off on phones [llama/30806](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30806) [llama/30687](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30687)

### ggml changes

- Bumped from v0.27.0 to [ggml v0.28.0](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases/tag/v0.28.0)
- New `GGML_OP_TOP_K_MASK` fused sparse-attention mask, plus accessors for the precision configured on a compute node
- `-1` is now a valid expert index in `MUL_MAT_ID`/`ADD_ID`: the slot is skipped and the output row zeroed
- `SCALE` accepts non-contiguous row views; `SUM` accepts non-contiguous inputs on CPU, CUDA, Vulkan and WebGPU
- Backends: fused MoE top-k and gate/up+GLU with chunked graph launches on CUDA, graph record/replay on SYCL
- Backends: Q2_K/Q3_K weights and a lightning indexer on OpenCL, subgroup reductions and `src1` precision on Vulkan
- More: restructured Hexagon HTP backend, flash attention on ZDNN, Q2_0 on WebGPU, KleidiAI SVE GEMV/GEMM kernels

Bundles CodeQL CLI v2.27.3
- ([changelog](https://github.com/github/codeql-cli-binaries/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md), [release](https://github.com/github/codeql-cli-binaries/releases/tag/v2.27.3))

The combined `codeql-bundle.tar.gz` covers Linux x64, Windows x64 and macOS (including Apple Silicon). Linux arm64 is available as the per-platform `codeql-bundle-linux-arm64.tar.gz` only.

Images pre-built for this release:

* https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/docs/user/quick-start/#creating-a-cluster
* https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/docs/user/quick-start/#building-images

NOTE: These node images support amd64 and arm64, both of our supported platforms. **You must use the same platform as your host,** for more context see [#2718](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kind/issues/2718)

# Fixes

* Respect Docker client proxy config for docker nodes. (#4192)

lycheeverse/lychee-action.body:
## Summary

This release updates the default lychee version from `v0.23.0` to `v0.24.2`.

The main reason for this release is compatibility with the new lychee `0.24.x` release artifacts. Starting with lychee `v0.24.0`, the archive layout changed, and the `lychee` binary may now be packaged inside a subdirectory. `lychee-action` now detects that layout automatically, so users can upgrade without changing their workflows.

If you use:

```yaml
uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
```

you will get the new version once the floating `v2` tag has been updated. If you pin exact versions, update to:

```yaml
uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2.9.0
```

## What’s new from lychee `v0.24.x`

### Better diagnostics

lychee now reports line and column numbers for detected links. This makes broken link reports easier to act on, especially in larger documentation sites or generated reports.

### Text fragment checking

lychee can now check URL text fragments, such as links containing `#:~:text=...`. This helps catch links that point to a valid page but no longer points to the intended highlighted text.

### Sitemap support

lychee can now read `sitemap.xml` inputs. This is useful for checking published websites or generated documentation sites where the sitemap is the easiest source of URLs to validate.

### JUnit output

lychee now supports JUnit output. This makes it easier to integrate link checking results with CI systems and test reporting tools that understand JUnit XML.

### Redirect and remap visibility

lychee can now show redirects and remaps more clearly. This helps explain why a URL was checked as a different final URL and makes debugging link-checking behavior easier.

### Multiple config files

lychee now supports multiple configuration files and expanded config handling. This is useful for repositories that split documentation, website, or package-specific link-checking settings.

### Timeout handling

lychee can now accept timeouts explicitly. This gives users more control over how strict their link checks should be for flaky or slow endpoints.

## Fixes and reliability improvements

### Fixed lychee `0.24.x` archive compatibility

`lychee-action` now handles the new lychee release archive layout by detecting whether the `lychee` binary is inside a subdirectory.

This fixes compatibility with lychee `0.24.x`.

### More stable installation path

The action now installs lychee into `$RUNNER_TEMP/lychee/bin` instead of `$HOME`.

This avoids failures on runners where `$HOME` differs between composite action steps. In those environments, the action could add one directory to `PATH` but install the binary somewhere else, causing `lychee: command not found`.

### Safer automatic lychee version updates

The workflow that checks for new lychee releases now guards against `null` release versions before creating update PRs. This prevents invalid automated PRs such as “Update lycheeVersion to null”.

### Dependency updates

- Updated `actions/checkout` from `v6` to `v7`
- Updated `actions/cache` from `v5` to `v6`

## Upstream lychee changelog

For the full lychee changelog, see:

- https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee/releases/tag/lychee-v0.24.0
- https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee/releases/tag/lychee-v0.24.1
- https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee/releases/tag/lychee-v0.24.2

## What’s Changed

* bump default to 0.24.1 and auto-detect lychee bin in subfolder by @kaitlyndotmoe in https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee-action/pull/330
* fixes #322 check for null by @bgermann in https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee-action/pull/336
* Install into `$RUNNER_TEMP` instead of `$HOME` by @mre in https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee-action/pull/338
* Bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @dependabot in https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee-action/pull/339
* Bump actions/cache from 5 to 6 by @dependabot in https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee-action/pull/340

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee-action/compare/v2.8.0...v2.9.0
